findings.source: SEC EDGAR 10-K FY2025 Item 3 Legal Proceedings
findings.excerpt: Based on current information and management assessment, we do not believe that a material loss from known matters is probable as of December 31, 2025.

findings.claim: 10-K 風險因子僅提及併購可能受適用反壟斷政策限制，及 FCPA 執法不確定；非針對公司的調查。
findings.excerpt: we may be unable to identify or complete prospective acquisitions for various reasons, including competition from other companies or financial investors, the valuation expectations of acquisition candidates and applicable antitrust or other policies, laws or regulations.

note: 搜尋未見 DOJ/FTC/EU 針對 MPWR 的反壟斷行動；僅有證券訴訟與專利訴訟。
